title: SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) - Band 25 (1900 MHz) for Public Safety Band Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Hiroshi Tanaka

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) filter targeting Band 25 (1900 MHz) for Public Safety Band Filter. The filter is designed on Langasite substrate with a target center frequency of 5036.0 MHz and bandwidth of 300.1 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Public Safety Band Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave)
- Frequency Band: Band 25 (1900 MHz)
- Application: Public Safety Band Filter
- Substrate: Langasite
- Package: Flip-Chip BGA
- Design Tool: Keysight ADS 2024
- Design Center: Singapore RF Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) design targeting Band 25 (1900 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       5036.0 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       300.1 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.8 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 16.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 33.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 22.0 dB
Q Factor:               2498
Temperature Coefficient:-13.0 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.0 x 2.0 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   10
Electrode Material:     Mo/Al
Passivation:            SiO2
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Keysight ADS 2024 and load the SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: Langasite with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 5036.0 MHz, BW 300.1 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.8 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (Flip-Chip BGA).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, Langasite).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N9041B UXA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 15108 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.8 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 16.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 450 MHz offset >= 33.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 4 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 8.2 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +34 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 98%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-01-24
Devices Tested:         89
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.49 dB
Return Loss (meas):     18.4 dB
Rejection (meas):       36.3 dB
Isolation (meas):       27.1 dB
Q Factor (meas):        2498
Group Delay Variation:  2.6 ns
Power Handling:         +35 dBm
Die Yield:              92.8%

Result Classification:  CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) design demonstrated acceptable performance for Band 25 (1900 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) No delamination observed after 1000-cycle thermal shock test.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
